role: Declarative lookup table of 287 English morphological exceptions for bootstrap loading into knowledge graph
detail: Single module-level constant: IRREGULAR_FORMS, a list of 348 dict entries (each with keys base, target, type). Covers ~71 noun plurals (vowel mutation, -en forms, zero-change, -f/-fe→-ves, Latin/Greek plurals), ~147 verb past tenses (high/medium frequency irregulars, phonological clusters like -ept/-elt/-ent/-ound/-ought), ~55 past participles differing from past tense, and ~14 comparatives/superlatives. All entries tagged with morphological type (plural, past_tense, past_participle, comparative, superlative). Loaded at bootstrap as TRANSFORMS_TO edges with is_regular=False flag. Provenance marked TAUGHT_PROCEDURE (procedural infrastructure per Ullman Declarative/Procedural model).
gotchas: No imports, no functions, no side effects—pure data file. Marked Phase 1.7 Language Foundation, CANON A.18. Depends on external bootstrap loader to insert into knowledge graph; this module is data-only.
